claims.content: Enable the Auctioneer to edit currently running or scheduled auctions, or remove items from them, via a searchable and filterable interface with bulk action capabilities.

goal.raw_text: Enable the Auctioneer to edit currently running or scheduled auctions, or remove items from them, via a searchable and filterable interface with bulk action capabilities.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer must be logged into the Auction Administration application.
There must be existing running or scheduled auctions in the system for the Auctioneer to edit or remove.
The Auctioneer must have appropriate user permissions to access the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions' page.
The Auctioneer navigates to the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions' page and initiates a search to find products for editing or removal.

trigger.raw_text: The Auctioneer navigates to the 'View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions' page and initiates a search to find products for editing or removal.

claims.content: If the Auctioneer attempts to create an auction with the same starting & ending date / time, the system displays an error message and highlights (color-codes) the offending data.

The selected items are removed from the auction, or their durations, bid increments, reserve amounts, ending times, starting times, or grouping/event assignments are updated as specified by the Auctioneer.
If an event profile was selected and applied, the selected event profile is applied to all selected items.
The system displays the 'Apply Changes' button in the bottom right corner of the screen (at 1024 x 768 resolution) to confirm that changes have been staged for application.

The search results display reflects the modifications made, with data displayed using the defined columns (e.g., Action, Item thumbnail image, Product ID, Auction ID number, Description, Opening Bid, High Bid, etc.) in the default order.
